description: This file defines the EmployeePictureService class, which manages employee picture storage, retrieval, sizing adjustments, and caching within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving pictures, fetching pictures with access control, adjusting image sizes, and handling caching and ETag generation.

classes.name: EmployeePictureService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee pictures, including saving, retrieving, resizing, and caching operations.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeePictureDao, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: pictureSizeAdjust
methods.description: Adjusts the image size to fit within 200x200 pixels while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: saveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Persists an EmpPicture entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an employee's picture by their employee number.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks user permissions and retrieves the employee picture if accessible.

methods.name: getEmpPictureETagByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches the ETag for an employee's picture, utilizing cache.

methods.name: deleteEmpPictureETagByEmpNumber
methods.description: Deletes the cached ETag for an employee's picture.

methods.name: getEmpPictureETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Generates and caches an ETag for an EmpPicture object.

methods.name: generateEmpPictureETagCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key for storing the ETag associated with an employee's picture.
